title: Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Pashrunya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Gittin 45b, reciting baraitot. In Menachot 42a the reading is Rav Chinena, and Hyman says this is the reading it should have, as found in Chullin 112a. Hyman places him in Rava’s time.[^1]

notes.text: William Davidson Gittin 45b has Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Pashrunya; Menachot 42a has Rav Chinena son of Rava, and Chullin 112a has Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya. Hyman’s statement that the reading should be Chinena and his dating to Rava’s time remain attributed judgments, without an identity merge.
